title: Legacy Candidate Codec Search
negative_results: a multi-candidate alias set refuses require_unique_pin (invariant 4)
a legacy source vector is refused as a location (refuse_source_as_geographic)
a vector no legacy codec admits yields a REFUSAL with an empty set, not a guess

claims.statement: Running all registered legacy codecs over one raw source vector gathers all admissible candidates into an alias set (0..N), each with codec_id, score, uncertainty, and search-space count (POWER multi-candidate).
A source vector yields candidates or a refusal, never a forced pin and never a decoded location.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs or personal data
